{{Top}}
A '''Coruscanti''' was a person born and raised on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], or who at least claimed permanent residence on the Galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. It was also a proper adjective to refer to anything related to, coming from, or similar to that on Coruscant. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was said to have a Coruscanti accent, as did some [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]].

The similarly derived term '''Coruscani''' saw use in the names of various entities associated with Coruscant, such as the [[Coruscani ogre]] and the [[Coruscani Pilot Institute]].
